# Media

A media attachment — photograph, video, or document scan. Used for identification, valuation, condition documentation, and provenance records

Source: [`v3/common/media.json`](../../../v3/common/media.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/media.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` (uri) | yes | URI pointing to the media file. May be an HTTPS URL, S3 URI, or other storage reference |
| `caption` | `string` | | Human-readable description of what this media shows |
| `mediaType` | `string` | | MIME type of the media file. Maps to Schema.org encodingFormat |
| `content` | `string` | | Base64-encoded media content for self-contained documents. Use for small files (attestation scans, signatures, certificates) that must travel with the estate plan. For large files (photos, videos), use url instead |
| `viewType` | one of `overview`, `identification`, `condition`, `provenance`, `maker_mark`, `serial_number`, `damage`, `scale_reference`, `label`, `certificate`, `receipt`, `environment` | | The purpose of this media — what question does it answer? Enables executors and dealers to find specific documentation without scrolling through galleries |
| `takenAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When this media was captured. Useful for establishing condition at a point in time |
| `thumbnailUrl` | `string` (uri) | | URI for a smaller preview version of the media. Maps to Schema.org thumbnail |
